headline: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
snapshot: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China. The larger angle is AI infrastructure: compute capacity, chip access and data-center economics are increasingly determining which companies can scale products for enterprise and government customers.
